### account page: the language control
$langRead = \Portal\Core\I18n::storedChoice($userId, $mysqli); $langUnknown = $langRead === false; $langStored = is_string($langRead) === true ? $langRead : ''; $langChoices = \Portal\Core\I18n::enabledLocales(); if ($langStored !== '' && isset($langChoices[$langStored]) === false) { $langStoredMeta = \Portal\Core\I18n::localeMeta($langStored); $langChoices[$langStored] = [ 'native' => ($langStoredMeta['native'] ?? $langStored), ]; } $langBrowser = \Portal\Core\I18n::browserLanguage(); $langBrowserMeta = $langBrowser === null ? null : \Portal\Core\I18n::localeMeta($langBrowser); $langBrowserWords = $langBrowser === null ? 'your browser asks for nothing this portal offers, so the default is used' : ((string) ($langBrowserMeta['native'] ?? $langBrowser)) . ' today'; ?> <?php if ($langUnknown === true): ?> <?php ?> <div class="mb-3"> <label class="form-label">Language</label> <div class="form-text"> We could not read your language setting just now, so it is not shown and nothing here will change it. Your language is unaffected. Please try again in a moment, or use the globe menu at the top of the page. </div> </div> <?php else: ?> <div class="mb-3"> <label for="locale" class="form-label">Language</label> <select class="form-select" id="locale" name="locale"> <option value=""<?php echo $langStored === '' ? ' selected' : ''; ?>> Follow my browser (<?php echo htmlspecialchars($langBrowserWords, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'); ?>) </option> <?php foreach ($langChoices as $langCode => $langMeta): ?> <?php $langPart = ''; if ((string) $langCode !== '' && isset($langMeta['native']) === true ) { $langCover = \Portal\Core\I18n::coverage((string) $langCode); $langPct = (int) round($langCover * 100); if ($langPct <= 0) { $langPart = ' — not translated yet, so every' . ' page reads in English'; } elseif ($langCover < 0.95) { $langPart = ' — ' . $langPct . '% translated, so some pages read in English'; } } ?> <option value="<?php echo htmlspecialchars((string) $langCode, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'); ?>" <?php echo $langStored === (string) $langCode ? ' selected' : ''; ?>> <?php echo htmlspecialchars((string) $langMeta['native'] . $langPart, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'); ?> </option> <?php endforeach
